verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows Poke supports integrations, MCP tool extensions, an API for triggering messages, and even human-assisted task completion (e.g., reservations), but there is no documentation describing an autonomous, multi-step background task workflow with a review/approval step for the user. Missing for 10: any docs on task planning/execution loops, background job status tracking, or a review/approval UI for completed autonomous tasks.
